items.title: Phil Wilson interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 27, 2023
items.q: Jimmy was a month before I joined the band. He died of smoking... So we were billed as the Jimmy Dorsey Band

ctx.x: So every night we played a dance somewhere and of course both Tommy and Jimmy at that point had died. Jimmy was a month before I joined the band. He died of smoking, you know cancer, same year [inaudible] Tommy died 18 months before of throwing up in his sleep after taking Seconal and all that sort of stuff. So we were billed as the Jimmy Dorsey Band but still Lee Castaldo was the leader at the time and Lee was a favorite of the Dorseys, both of them, because Tommy loved his playing and so did Jimmy for that…

Did the anticipation of joining a well-known big band equal the experience when you got with the band then you went on the road on a bus every day, did it get to be the same? Did it get to be this realization that this life is not necessarily what I thought it would be?
